gloss: to exploit someone's weakness; to take advantage of a vulnerability

definitions.gloss: to exploit someone's weakness; to take advantage of a vulnerability
definitions.explanation: To take unfair advantage of another person's vulnerable position, difficult circumstances, or shortcomings for one's own benefit. Always carries a negative, morally critical connotation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弱|よわ}みに{付|つ}け{込|こ}むな。
⟦{悪徳|あくとく}→悪徳：29368_akutoku⟧⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弱|よわ}みに{付|つ}け{込|こ}む。
examples.english: Unscrupulous businesses exploit the vulnerabilities of the elderly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弱|よわ}みに{付|つ}け{込|こ}んで⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{有利|ゆうり}→有利：03651_yuuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}めた→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: He exploited the other party's weakness to steer the negotiations in his favor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弱|よわ}みに{付|つ}け{込|こ}む⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{卑怯|ひきょう}→卑怯：04345_hikyou⟧だ。
examples.english: It's cowardly to exploit the weakness of someone in trouble.

notes:
An idiomatic expression meaning to take unfair advantage of someone's vulnerable position. Always carries a negative connotation — it implies underhanded or morally questionable behavior.

USAGE:
The person whose weakness is being exploited is marked with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧:
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弱|よわ}みに{付|つ}け{込|こ}む
- ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弱|よわ}みに{付|つ}け{込|こ}む

⟦{付|つ}け{込|こ}む→付け込む：10372_tsukekomu⟧ is a godan verb (⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ conjugation), so the expression conjugates at the end: ⟦{付|つ}け{込|こ}んだ→付け込む：10372_tsukekomu⟧, ⟦{付|つ}け{込|こ}まない→付け込む：10372_tsukekomu⟧, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弱|よわ}みに{付|つ}け{込|こ}む: to exploit someone's weakness
- ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弱|よわ}みに{付|つ}け{込|こ}む: to take advantage of the opponent's vulnerability
- ⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弱|よわ}みに{付|つ}け{込|こ}む: to exploit someone's weak position

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{足元|あしもと}→足元：04096_ashimoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to take advantage of someone's situation — implies sizing up someone's weakness for exploitation
- ⟦{漬|つ}け{込|こ}む→漬け込む：09007_tsukekomu⟧: to exploit (older kanji variant) — same pronunciation but different kanji; the ⟦{付|つ}け{込|こ}む→付け込む：10372_tsukekomu⟧ form is standard here
- ⟦{利用|りよう}する→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧: to take advantage of — more neutral, can be positive or negative
